_about: FLAMEPRINT material catalog. oxygenThreshold.o2Pct is the 1 g limiting oxygen index (LOI, ASTM D2863 / ISO 4589) and MUST carry a cited source; null means 'not sourced yet' and the material shows unknown risk with grade M. LOI is a 1 g candle-like test, NOT a spacecraft acceptance test (NASA-STD-6001 Test 1) — the material verdict is an illustrative model that shifts the 1 g LOI by a schematic gravity/airflow curve. All 8 thresholds are now sourced from materials-science literature (2026-11-14), each with a citation; silicone uses a typical commercial-grade value (unfilled PDMS is lower). testedIn is taken from the seed catalog fuel lists and must be verified against PSI test records. See docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md.

materials.name: Cotton fabric
materials.testedInBasis: Seed catalog fuel list (investigation-level metadata). Verify against PSI test records.

oxygenThreshold.basis: 1 g limiting oxygen index (ASTM D2863 / ISO 4589); untreated cotton
oxygenThreshold.source: Islam et al., 'Cotton-based Flame-retardant Textiles: A Review', BioResources 16(2):4354 (2021): untreated cotton LOI 16-22% (commonly ~18%)

materials.notes: Catalog lists cotton-fiberglass fabric (SIBAL), a cotton blend, not pure cotton. LOI 18% is for untreated 100% cotton; the SIBAL blend's fiberglass backing is non-combustible, so pure-cotton LOI is the conservative input.

materials.name: Polyurethane foam

oxygenThreshold.basis: 1 g limiting oxygen index (ASTM D2863 / ISO 4589); virgin flexible foam
oxygenThreshold.source: Fire and Materials (2018): virgin flexible polyurethane foam LOI 17.0-21.3% (TDI- and MDI-based); ~18% taken as a conservative value

materials.notes: Flexible PU foam is highly flammable; value is for virgin (non-flame-retarded) foam.

materials.name: PMMA (acrylic)
materials.testedInBasis: Seed catalog fuel list (investigation-level metadata). Verify against PSI test records.

oxygenThreshold.basis: 1 g limiting oxygen index (ASTM D2863 / ISO 4589)
oxygenThreshold.source: Lyon, Janssens et al., 'The Limiting Oxygen Index test revisited': PMMA LOI 17.0 (ASTM D2863-06). (Industry tables list 17-19%.)

materials.notes: PMMA is the canonical microgravity solid fuel (burned in BASS/BASS-II).

materials.name: Nomex

oxygenThreshold.basis: 1 g limiting oxygen index (ASTM D2863 / ISO 4589); untreated meta-aramid
oxygenThreshold.source: Aramid datasheets & ASTM D-2863 measurements: untreated Nomex LOI ~28% (range 28-31%). NASA (NTRS 20070018178) noted Nomex failed at 30% O2 in a 'J' configuration.

materials.notes: Fire-resistant in 21% air (LOI 28 > 21), but elevated-O2 habitats (e.g. 34% O2 Moon base) exceed its LOI, so it can burn there — a key high-O2 warning.

materials.name: PTFE (Teflon) wire insulation

oxygenThreshold.basis: 1 g limiting oxygen index (ASTM D2863 / ISO 4589)
oxygenThreshold.source: Polymer flammability references (SpecialChem fire-resistance/LOI guide; ASTM D2863 tables): PTFE LOI ~95%

materials.notes: Among the least flammable common polymers; effectively non-combustible at habitat O2 levels. Apollo 13 showed the separate hazard of Teflon insulation degrading under electrical/thermal fault.

materials.name: Velcro (nylon hook and loop)

oxygenThreshold.basis: 1 g limiting oxygen index (ASTM D2863 / ISO 4589); nylon 6,6
oxygenThreshold.source: Nylon 6,6 oxygen index ~24-29% (unreinforced nylon 6/6 measured ~29%, ScienceDirect Oxygen Index overview); ~24% taken as conservative

materials.notes: Hook-and-loop fasteners are typically nylon 6,6. Value is for the base polymer.

materials.name: Paper
materials.testedInBasis: Seed catalog fuel list (investigation-level metadata). Verify against PSI test records.

oxygenThreshold.basis: 1 g limiting oxygen index (ASTM D2863 / ISO 4589); untreated cellulose paper
oxygenThreshold.source: Chen et al., 'Phytic acid flame-retardant cellulose paper', BioResources 16(4):7953 (2021): untreated cellulose paper LOI ~19.6% (ASTM D2863)

materials.notes: Paper is near-pure cellulose; measured untreated value ~19.6% (close to cotton, as expected). Catalog lists thin cellulose, which is close to, but not the same as, paper.

materials.name: Silicone rubber
materials.testedInBasis: Seed catalog fuel list (investigation-level metadata). Verify against PSI test records.

oxygenThreshold.basis: 1 g limiting oxygen index (ASTM D2863 / ISO 4589); typical commercial silicone rubber (VMQ)
oxygenThreshold.source: Typical silicone rubber (VMQ/PMQ/PVMQ) LOI ~32% (MakeItFrom material data; Wacker Elastosil R 501/75 datasheet, ASTM D2863). Unfilled PDMS is lower (~21%); exact value depends on the flown grade.

materials.notes: Value is for a typical filled commercial silicone rubber (seals/gaskets/tubing). Unfilled silicone/PDMS can sit near 21%; confirm against the grade actually flown. Catalog lists silicone among multiple spacecraft materials (SAFFIRE-II).
